title: Message
description: Direct message or private message between users with sender/receiver information, content, message type, read status, and timestamps. Used for messaging systems, chat applications, and private communication platforms.

conversation_id.description: Foreign key reference to the conversation this message belongs to

sender_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who sent the message

sender_name.description: Full name of the message sender

receiver_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who receives the message

receiver_name.description: Full name of the message receiver

type.description: Message type (e.g., text, image, file, system)

read.description: Whether the message has been read by the receiver

created_at.description: Timestamp when the message was sent

read_at.description: Timestamp when the message was read, null if unread
